title: 3D title inside a photo
description: 3D inside a 3D photo: a big 3D title placed between the far houses and the nearest building of a blue-hour old-town street (CC0), so the facade hides part of the letters, with snow falling both in front of and behind the buildings. The photo writes its depth (`occlude: true`) and its pointer / gyro / sway motion moves the real camera, so the title slides exactly with the street around it. Data-bound title and subtitle.
